# Shared Google Drive for Dr. Love and Students in 431

The Shared Google Drive for this class will appear to you on 2025-09-01.

- Everyone taking the class will (eventually) need to access this drive and some of the materials stored on it.

To reach the shared Google Drive once September 1 has arrived...

1. Log into CWRU in the usual way, as you would to view your email.

2. Click on the grid of nine dots (3x3) at the top right of your screen (near your CWRU name) to look at the available tools you have.

3. Click on **Drive**.

4. Click on **Shared drives** on the left side of the screen below the **My Drive** folder.

5. Select the drive called **431 Fall 2025 Materials for Students and Dr Love**, if you see it.

Contact Dr. Love at `Thomas dot Love at case dot edu` if you have any questions.
